name: How much does it cost to install an adjustable showerhead?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to install an adjustable showerhead?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to install an adjustable showerhead varies depending on whether it's a simple replacement or a more complex installation involving plumbing alterations. A basic DIY replacement might only cost the price of the showerhead itself. Professional installation by a contractor can range from $75 to $200 for a straightforward swap, plus the cost of the unit. More intricate jobs, such as relocating the shower arm or repairing existing plumbing, will incur higher labor and material costs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary; a simple DIY replacement is just the showerhead, while professional installation can range from $75-$200+ depending on complexity.
